observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a bare automotive engine assembly, likely removed from a vehicle, sitting on a workshop floor.

Visible components: aluminum cylinder head with four black ignition coil packs (suggesting a 4-cylinder layout), valve cover with an 'ENGINE OIL' cap, serpentine belt, pulleys, alternator, and various hoses/sensors.
No manufacturer badge, part-number sticker, or casting number is legible in either photo.
A watermark reading 'EMMY GOLD AUTO SPARE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' appears on both photos — this is the seller's shop branding, not an engine marking.
No wiring harness, intake manifold, or ECU is clearly visible, so it is unclear if the engine is sold complete.
No photo shows the engine running, a compression test, or an odometer/mileage sticker.

claims.evidence: No badge, sticker, or casting number reading 'Hyundai' or 'Kia' is visible in photo 0 or photo 1.
Photo 0 shows four ignition coil packs in a row, consistent with 4 cylinders, but no engine code or displacement marking is visible to confirm the exact model.

risks.risk: Engine make/model cannot be confirmed, which determines fitment and price tier
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code/casting number stamped on the block (usually near the block-to-transmission mating surface) or a legible manufacturer sticker
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unidentified 4-cylinder used engine, lowest tier for that size class

risks.risk: Running condition unknown — could be a dead or heavily worn unit
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine starting and idling, or a compression test reading
Odometer photo from donor vehicle or mileage sticker on engine

risks.risk: Completeness uncertain — intake manifold, ECU, wiring harness, turbo (if applicable) may be missing
risks.proof: Full 360-degree photo set showing intake side, harness connectors, and manifold
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare long block only, missing ancillaries

risks.risk: Internal wear/sludge not visible from outside
risks.proof: Photo/video of oil on dipstick or inside valve cover when opened
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming unknown internal condition, no premium for 'clean' claim

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code or casting number stamped on the block
Video of the engine starting and running to confirm it works
Photo showing the intake manifold side and whether wiring harness/ECU are included
Any documentation or sticker showing mileage/donor vehicle
response.reason: The photos show a plausible 4-cylinder engine but no legible brand/model marking, and the exact Hyundai/Kia model is essential to price this correctly since values vary widely across their engine range; a close-up of the engine code is needed before even a worst-case price can be set.
